topic.readerProblem: Someone searching "security headers" wants to run the check immediately and know what the result means for their site.
topic.connection: The free SEO audit runs this check site-wide (crawlability, on-page, speed, schema, HTTPS); this page is the single-URL version and links into it.

sources.supports: HSTS syntax: max-age, includeSubDomains, preload; ignored over plain HTTP.
Content Security Policy limits which resources and scripts run.
HTTPS is a very lightweight ranking signal, affecting fewer than 1% of queries (2014).
AEOeye 391-site baseline: redirects, headers, meta tags, OG/X tags, icons, JSON-LD, image formats, blog location, soft 404s.
